briefdescription.para: ForceFramePointer - True if the function is required to use of frame pointer for reasons other than it containing dynamic allocation or that FP eliminatation is turned off.

detaileddescription.para: For example, Cygwin main function contains stack pointer re-alignment code which requires FP.

briefdescription.para: RestoreBasePointerOffset - Non-zero if the function has base pointer and makes call to llvm.eh.sjlj.setjmp.

detaileddescription.para: When non-zero, the value is a displacement from the frame pointer to a slot where the base pointer is stashed.

briefdescription.para: WinEHXMMSlotInfo - Slot information of XMM registers in the stack frame in bytes.
CalleeSavedFrameSize - Size of the callee-saved register portion of the stack frame in bytes.
BytesToPopOnReturn - Number of bytes function pops on return (in addition to the space used by the return address).

detaileddescription.para: Used on windows platform for stdcall & fastcall name decoration

briefdescription.para: ReturnAddrIndex - FrameIndex for return slot.
FrameIndex for return slot.
TailCallReturnAddrDelta - The number of bytes by which return address stack slot is moved as the result of tail call optimization.
SRetReturnReg - Some subtargets require that sret lowering includes returning the value of the returned struct in a register.

detaileddescription.para: This field holds the virtual register into which the sret argument is passed.

briefdescription.para: GlobalBaseReg - keeps track of the virtual register initialized for use as the global base register.

detaileddescription.para: This is used for PIC in some PIC relocation models.

briefdescription.para: VarArgsFrameIndex - FrameIndex for start of varargs area.
RegSaveFrameIndex - X86-64 vararg func register save area.
VarArgsGPOffset - X86-64 vararg func int reg offset.
VarArgsFPOffset - X86-64 vararg func fp reg offset.
ArgumentStackSize - The number of bytes on stack consumed by the arguments being passed on the stack.
NumLocalDynamics - Number of local-dynamic TLS accesses.
HasPushSequences - Keeps track of whether this function uses sequences of pushes to pass function parameters.
True if the function recovers from an SEH exception, and therefore needs to spill and restore the frame pointer.
The frame index of a stack object containing the original frame pointer used to address arguments in a function using a base pointer.
The AMX programing model used in the function.
True if this function has a subset of CSRs that is handled explicitly via copies.
True if this function uses the red zone.
True if this function has DYN_ALLOCA instructions.
True if this function has any preallocated calls.
Whether this function has an extended frame record [Ctx, RBP, Return addr].

detaileddescription.para: If so, bit 60 of the in-memory frame pointer will be 1 to enable other tools to detect the extended record.

briefdescription.para: Ajust stack for push2/pop2.
Candidate registers for push2/pop2.
True if this function has CFI directives that adjust the CFA.

detaileddescription.para: This is used to determine if we should direct the debugger to use the CFA instead of the stack pointer.

briefdescription.para: ForwardedMustTailRegParms - A list of virtual and physical registers that must be forwarded to every musttail call.

briefdescription.para: Make a functionally equivalent copy of this MachineFunctionInfo in MF.

detaileddescription.para: This requires remapping MachineBasicBlock references from the original parent to values in the new function. Targets may assume that virtual register and frame index values are preserved in the new function.

briefdescription.para: X86MachineFunctionInfo - This class is derived from MachineFunction and contains private X86 target-specific information for each MachineFunction.
